dedupe_keys.name: chhai coupled hydrology human activity information benchmark dataset

description: CHHAI is a benchmark dataset of coupled human-water information for more than twenty river and lake basins on every continent except Antarctica, modelled on the MOPEX hydrological benchmark but covering human influences: reservoir management, flood protection, river management policies, land use change, and water use and withdrawal. It is meant for validating, verifying and comparing socio-hydrological and coupled human-water models. An international team led by Azara Boschee published it on HydroShare in July 2025 and updated it in June 2026; it is available as a free download under a CC BY licence. Coverage is global in spread but limited to the selected basins. Caveats: the file formats and time spans differ by basin and were not listed in the metadata read. Simulation uses: calibrating and comparing agent-based and network models of dam operation, irrigation withdrawals and flood protection, and climate adaptation studies. Related record: the CONUS reservoir simulations under CMIP6 (data-cmip6-mosartwmpy-conus-reservoir-inflow-storage-release).
